title: Ampere's law (2D, 3D)
description: The circulation of B around closed paths equals mu0 times the current they enclose. 2-D: B from a finite-volume solution of lap A_z = -mu0 J_z for a rectangular conductor, integrated around a circle, a square and a path that encloses nothing. 3-D: B of a square loop (Biot-Savart) around paths that link it once, twice (a path winding twice) and not at all.
